# ADR 0002 — Design system generated by ui-ux-pro-max, with two documented overrides

Status: accepted, 2026-11-19.

## Context

The product owner asked for the UI to be designed using
`https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill`. The skill produces a design
system from a searchable local database of styles, palettes, typography and UX rules.

The product also carries a binding constraint from the original brief: "Very simple UI,
only required buttons, only required decorations."

## Decision

Generate the design system with the skill and persist it as the visual source of truth:

```
design-system/letxnepal/MASTER.md   # human-readable rules
design-system/letxnepal/tokens.json # W3C DTCG tokens
design-system/letxnepal/tokens.css  # :root custom properties
```

Components consume semantic tokens only. `tests/tokens.test.ts` fails the build on a raw
hex value, on a contrast pair below 4.5:1, or on a font without Devanagari coverage.

## Override 1 — font

The generator recommended **Noto Sans Thai** for this query. That family has no
Devanagari glyphs, so Nepali text would fall back to a system font. Replaced with
**Mukta** (Devanagari + Latin) and **Noto Sans Devanagari** as fallback.

Recorded in `MASTER.md` and `docs/provenance.md`. A test guards the correction.

## Override 2 — motion

The generator's landing pattern is `Scroll-Triggered Storytelling` (parallax,
scroll-scrubbed chapters). That conflicts with the brief's simplicity mandate, and the
generator's own anti-pattern for this product type is "Generic photos + Complex booking".

Decision: keep the pattern's content order (hook → problem → journey → solution → CTA)
and drop the scroll-driven motion. `--motion` is pinned to 2; no GSAP in v1.

## Consequences

- The visual language is derived from a database rather than invented, and it is
  reproducible: the same query regenerates the same system.
- Two recommendations were knowingly overridden, with reasons recorded where a future
  contributor will see them.
- Contrast is verified numerically in CI rather than by eye.
- Any future change to the design system must be a regeneration plus a documented
  override, not a hand edit of component styles.

## Not adopted

`JuliusBrussee/caveman` was suggested for token management. It is an LLM token-reduction
toolkit (terse agent output, compressed tool reads) with no design-token capability. The
design-token pipeline here is `ui-ux-pro-max` plus the token tests. See
`docs/design-notes.md`.
